turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
Not yet. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went in?
You're very sharp, you know that?
Save it. What do you have besides the software?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't caught anything. You haven't shown me a timestamp, so show me one.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
You didn't flag it, Hale. You entered a zero. On what?
